name: The Quartermaster
label: Quest
description: The Quartermaster: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, our quartermaster charged me to direct new recruits to him. He needs supplies from caches stored in the mines of Alterac, and he'll probably send you to get them.
Follow the road. You'll find our quartermaster to the west.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It's good to see fresh troops here, friend, but with a little luck you'll get into some action and won't be fresh for long!
Speak with me again. I have tasks I must discuss with you....
